circleTeaser: Hariyali Teej tomorrow. Green is custom; devotion is the vrat. A simple home puja is enough.

dpb.confidenceNote: Parvati's tapasya and Shiva's acceptance of her on this Tritiya are told in the Purana; green attire, swings and mehndi are regional custom.

en.title: Hariyali Teej
en.heroSubtitle: The Shravana Tritiya of Parvati's devotion — kept with love, not fear.
en.deck: The story behind the green Teej, what the vrat actually asks of you, and a complete home vidhi for Shiva and Parvati.
en.introHtml: At the heart of this day is a story from the Shiva Purana: Parvati's long tapasya to be united with Shiva, and his acceptance of her on this Tritiya. The vrat observed today is a way of stepping into that same devotion — not a transaction, but a remembering.

blocks.title: Why this vrat
blocks.text: By her unwavering tapasya on this Tritiya of Shravana, Parvati won what no offering of wealth could win — the heart of Shiva himself.

meta.attribution: Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita — Parvati Khanda

blocks.title: Begin with Sankalp
blocks.text: Before the puja, before the fast — sit quietly and state your intention. This is the first act, not a preparation for the ritual. The sankalpa is the ritual's beginning.

sankalpa.gloss: I observe this vrat today with devotion, for the wellbeing of my loved ones and the grace of Shiva–Parvati. No Sanskrit required — sincerity is the sankalp.

samagri.name: Shiva–Parvati image or idol
samagri.note: size and material do not matter

steps.title: Bathe and dress
steps.description: Full bath before the puja. Wear fresh clothes. Green is traditional for Hariyali Teej, but any clean clothes are fine.
steps.note: Green attire and bangles are regional custom — not a scriptural rule.

steps.title: Set up the altar
steps.description: Place an image or idol of Lord Shiva, Maa Parvati and Ganesha on a clean cloth. Size and material do not matter.

steps.title: Abhishek — offer to Lord Shiva
steps.description: Pour water or milk over the Shivling or image. Panchamrit if you have it — clean water is completely fine.

steps.title: Offer to Maa Parvati
steps.description: Sindoor, bangles and flowers placed before Maa Parvati. You're offering what you wear yourself — an act of solidarity with her tapasya.

steps.title: Vrat Katha
steps.description: The sacred story — why this day exists. Listen or read. Both are equal.

steps.title: Evening aarti and bhajans
steps.description: Light a diya, do aarti, sing or play a bhajan. Jhula (swing) gatherings and Teej songs close the day in many homes.
steps.note: Swings, mehndi and Teej songs are beloved pratha, not a requirement.

dpb.prathaScope: North India — strongest in Rajasthan, UP, Bihar, Haryana

steps.title: Break the fast — Udyapan
steps.description: Next morning after a bath. Or after moonrise this evening if you observed a Sajal or Phalahar fast. The vrat is complete.

mantra.meaning: I bow to Lord Shiva, the auspicious one.

blocks.title: Vrat Katha — the sacred story
blocks.text: Parvati, born to Himavan, resolved that she would accept no one but Shiva. Through years of tapasya — in heat, in rain, on a single leaf's worth of food and then on nothing at all — she held to that resolve. On the Tritiya of Shravana's bright fortnight, Shiva accepted her. The green of this day is the green of that monsoon; the vrat is a remembering of a devotion that asked for nothing except union with the divine.

meta.attribution: Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita / Parvati Khanda

blocks.title: Your fast today

fasting.name: Nirjala
fasting.description: No food or water at all. Only for the able-bodied and experienced.

fasting.name: Sajal
fasting.description: Water is allowed through the day. One sattvik meal after the evening puja.

fasting.name: Phalahar
fasting.description: Fruit-based diet. Right for pregnancy, illness and age.

blocks.text: No source text mandates nirjala. A sincere, gentler fast is a complete vrat. The devotion matters — not the difficulty.

myths.question: Must I wear green and new bangles for the vrat to count?
myths.answer: No. Green attire, mehndi and bangles are beautiful regional custom — pratha, not Dharma. The vrat is the sankalp, the puja and the fast.

myths.question: I am unmarried, or widowed. Can I keep this vrat?
myths.answer: Yes. Parvati herself was unmarried when she kept her tapasya. No Puranic source bars anyone from this vrat; restrictions you may have heard are custom, not scripture.

myths.question: I broke my fast by mistake. Is the vrat ruined?
myths.answer: No. Complete the day with devotion and continue. No text attaches punishment to an honest lapse.

hi.title: हरियाली तीज
hi.heroSubtitle: श्रावण की तृतीया — पार्वती की भक्ति का दिन, बिना भय के।
hi.deck: हरी तीज की कथा, व्रत वास्तव में क्या माँगता है, और शिव-पार्वती की सम्पूर्ण घरेलू पूजा विधि।
hi.introHtml: इस दिन के केंद्र में शिव पुराण की एक कथा है: शिव को पाने के लिए पार्वती की लम्बी तपस्या, और इसी तृतीया को शिव द्वारा उन्हें स्वीकारना। आज का व्रत उसी भक्ति में उतरने का मार्ग है — कोई सौदा नहीं, एक स्मरण।
